title: hermes-studiotwin host<->gateway protocol v1 (frozen, S03)
description: Host context (D31), host capability handshake and dashboard-backend IPC envelope. Exact-match versioning.

ProtocolV1.description: Exact-match protocol label. Any other value is refused.

MediatedTextV1.description: Text that has passed the S06/S07 result-mediation boundary (D20). Never carries a URL, storage URI, presigned field, query string or credential.

HostContextV1.description: What the gateway knows about its caller. On unmodified pinned core (no D31) this is the untrusted variant and carries no identity at all: setup-only.

TrustedToolContextV1.x-transport: reserved MCP request _meta, never tool arguments
TrustedToolContextV1.description: D31 core dependency: populated by core after model arguments, MAC'd with an ephemeral per-process key inherited at spawn. Absent, model-argument copies, bad MACs, stale nonces and cross-session reuse are rejected.

HostCapabilitiesV1.description: Supplied by the same running core process during initialize (§5.3). Importing another installation never satisfies it.

IpcRequestV1.description: Dashboard backend -> gateway over the package-local socket (§5.3). MAC over the canonical request with the boot capability; replayed nonces fail. Current authenticated scope/generation derives from peer and boot capability, never params. S05/S11 must call validate_mediated_v1 before sending or logging; operations.quote additionally validates raw candidates. uploads.putChunk is bounded binary upload content only, never display text; metadata must match the bound upload session and maxBytes, offsets must be contiguous/idempotent.

IpcResponseV1.description: Method-discriminated mediated result. S05/S11 compare result.method and requestId to the exact outstanding authenticated request before consuming. Validate the entire envelope with gateway.redaction.validate_mediated_v1 before serialization, forwarding, logging, caching or UI. Unknown payloads are refused, never forwarded raw.

IpcStreamDescriptorV1.description: Scoped backend stream descriptor only. Resolve handle with current scope/generation, purpose, expiry/read count and full open/fstat sandbox. No backend path or upstream URL. S11 binds HTTP Range to the validated stream and caps bytes; a descriptor is not authorization outside its bound scope.
